fields.description: ASCII header identifier 'DRGBA7' at the start of the 24-byte EEPROM header block.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f684 reads EEPROM blocks 0-2 (file offsets 0x00-0x17) into RAM; FUN_0802f6b4 writes the same 0x18-byte header back; FUN_0802f538 copies ROM default header before the full 0x40-block write. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x00-0x05 are 44 52 47 42 41 37 ('DRGBA7').
fields.name: header_magic

fields.description: Header parameter block of the 24-byte EEPROM header. Non-zero version stamp bytes at file offsets 0x0C-0x0F (15, 8, 6, 1) and flag byte 0x10 (1); exact per-byte meaning unconfirmed.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f684(0,3,...) and FUN_0802f6b4(0,0x40,...) transfer this 0x18-byte header as one block (FUN_0802f4f0 recomputes its checksum at +0x16); baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x06-0x15 verified non-blank at 0x0C-0x10.
fields.name: header_params

fields.description: Per-track result records group A: 17 tracks x 4-byte little-endian entries (0x11 stride-4 copies). Exact stat meaning unconfirmed; mirrored with group B/C layout.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f1a0 copies 0x11 x 4-byte entries from save-record +0x00 into RAM tables (uVar4*4 stride); FUN_0802f280 merges the same range and FUN_0802f608 checksums it inside the 0xE8-byte record.
fields.name: track_results_a

fields.description: Per-track result records group B: 17 tracks x 4-byte little-endian entries. High byte of each entry encodes a 1st/2nd/3rd-place podium finish.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f1a0 copies 0x11 x 4-byte entries from save-record +0x44 into RAM tables at +0x6c; FUN_08007f88 tests (byte-1)<3 at entry offset +0x6f over 0x11 entries to derive unlock flags.
fields.name: track_results_b

fields.description: Per-track result records group C: 17 tracks x 4-byte little-endian entries. High byte of each entry encodes a 1st/2nd/3rd-place podium finish.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f1a0 copies 0x11 x 4-byte entries from save-record +0x88 into RAM tables at +0xb0; FUN_08007f88 tests (byte-1)<3 at entry offset +0xb3 over 0x11 entries to derive unlock flags.
fields.name: track_results_c

fields.description: Per-track best rank bytes, one per each of 17 tracks. Save path keeps the minimum non-zero value of live table vs stored byte (lower is better).
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f280 min-nonzero merges 0x11 bytes at save-record +0xCC against the live table; FUN_0802f1a0 copies the same 0x11 bytes (save +0xCC) into RAM tables at +0x10.
fields.name: track_best_rank

fields.description: Slot validity marker. 0x11 in a freshly initialized, checksum-valid slot (written by FUN_0802f410); save-prep path FUN_0802f280 overwrites it with its status argument before the final checksum.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802f4b0 validates the 0xE8-byte record checksum then returns min(byte at record +0xDD, 0x11); FUN_0802f410 stores 0x11 at record +0xDD; FUN_0802f280 stores 0x11 then its param_2 at record +0xDD. File offset 0xF5 = record base 0x18 + 0xDD; baseline value 0x11.
fields.name: slot_status

fields.description: Persisted profile unlock flag A. Set to 1 in RAM when more than 11 group-C track entries hold a podium value, then saved to the record.
fields.evidence: FUN_08007f88 sets RAM byte +0x21 to 1 when its group-C podium tally exceeds 0xB; FUN_0802f280 persists RAM +0x21 to save-record +0xDE and FUN_0802f1a0 loads save-record +0xDE back to RAM +0x21. File offset 0xF6 = record base 0x18 + 0xDE.
fields.name: profile_unlock_a

fields.description: Persisted profile unlock flag B. Set to 1 in RAM when more than 11 group-B track entries hold a podium value, then saved to the record.
fields.evidence: FUN_08007f88 sets RAM byte +0x22 to 1 when its group-B podium tally exceeds 0xB; FUN_0802f280 persists RAM +0x22 to save-record +0xDF and FUN_0802f1a0 loads save-record +0xDF back to RAM +0x22. File offset 0xF7 = record base 0x18 + 0xDF.
fields.name: profile_unlock_b

fields.description: Persisted profile unlock flag C. Set to 1 in RAM by the podium-count evaluation, then saved to the record.
fields.evidence: FUN_08007f88 sets RAM byte +0x23 to 1 in its podium-count evaluation branch; FUN_0802f280 persists RAM +0x23 to save-record +0xE0 and FUN_0802f1a0 loads save-record +0xE0 back to RAM +0x23. File offset 0xF8 = record base 0x18 + 0xE0.
fields.name: profile_unlock_c

fields.description: Persisted profile progress counter evaluated against 0xB (11) in the podium-count routine; exact capped range unconfirmed so no constraint is given.
fields.evidence: FUN_08007f88 compares RAM byte +0xF against 0xB and substitutes 0xC in the unlock branch; FUN_0802f280 persists RAM +0xF to save-record +0xE1 and FUN_0802f1a0 loads save-record +0xE1 back to RAM +0xF. File offset 0xF9 = record base 0x18 + 0xE1.
fields.name: profile_progress_count

fields.description: Persisted profile completion tier: 0 = none, raised to 1/2/3 when the combined podium tally exceeds 4, 9, and 14.
fields.evidence: FUN_08007f88 writes RAM byte +0x24 to 1/2/3 at tally thresholds >4, >9, >0xE; FUN_0802f280 persists RAM +0x24 to save-record +0xE2 and FUN_0802f1a0 loads save-record +0xE2 back to RAM +0x24. File offset 0xFA = record base 0x18 + 0xE2.
fields.name: profile_complete_tier
